name: Maat
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Maat is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Luke. He is the son of Mattathias and the father of Naggai. Although little is known about his life, he plays an important role in the messianic lineage connecting David to Jesus.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Maat is listed as one of Jesus' ancestors in the genealogy recorded by the evangelist Luke. He is placed between Mattathias and Naggai in the line of generations.

keyEvents.title: Part of the messianic line
keyEvents.description: Through his place in the genealogy, Maat is part of the unbroken line from God through Adam and David to Jesus Christ, the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the lineage of David
keyEvents.description: Maat belongs to the branch of David's descendants that Luke follows through Nathan, David's son, in contrast to Matthew who follows the royal line through Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: Maat is part of the generations after Zerubbabel, who led the Jews back from exile in Babylon, and represents the continuity of God's promises to His people.
